arxiv-2111-08764.creator: T. A. Silva, O.D.S Demangeon, S. C. C. Barros, D. J. Armstrong, J. F. Otegi, D. Bossini, E. Delgado Mena, S. G. Sousa, V. Adibekyan, L. D. Nielsen, C. Dorn, J. Lillo-Box, N. C. Santos, S. Hoyer, K. G. Stassun, J. M. Almenara, D. Bayliss, D. Barrado, I. Boisse, D. J. A. Brown, R. F. Díaz, X. Dumusque
arxiv-2111-08764.description: Abstract Context. Most of the currently known planets are small worlds with radii between that of the Earth and that of Neptune. The characterization of planets in this regime shows a large diversity in compositions and system architectures, with distributions hinting at a multitude of formation and evolution scenarios.

arxiv-2202-08024.title: Towards AutoQML: A Cloud-Based Automated Circuit Architecture Search Framework
arxiv-2202-08024.creator: Raúl Berganza Gómez, Corey O’Meara, Giorgio Cortiana, Christian B. Mendl, Juan Bernabé-Moreno
arxiv-2202-08024.description: Abstract The learning process of classical machine learning algorithms is tuned by hyperparameters that need to be customized to best learn and generalize from an input dataset. In recent years, Quantum Machine Learning (QML) has been gaining traction as a possible application of quantum computing which may provide quantum advantage in the future.

arxiv-2205-07332.title: Fluctuations in the canonical ensemble of an Abelian charge
arxiv-2205-07332.creator: Bengt Friman, Krzysztof Redlich
arxiv-2205-07332.description: Abstract We study fluctuations in the canonical ensemble, where the net baryon number is exactly conserved. The focus is on cumulants and factorial cumulants linked to the baryon and antibaryon multiplicities and their sum or difference in full phase-space as well as in subsystems.

arxiv-2206-05755.title: Classification and measurement of multipartite entanglement by reconstruction of correlation tensors on an NMR quantum processor
arxiv-2206-05755.creator: Vaishali Gulati, Arvind, Kavita Dorai
arxiv-2206-05755.description: Abstract We introduce a protocol to classify three-qubit pure states into different entanglement classes and implement it on an NMR quantum processor. The protocol is designed in such a way that the experiments performed to classify the states can also measure the amount of entanglement present in the state.

arxiv-2308-12356.title: Gluon TMD fragmentation function into quarkonium
arxiv-2308-12356.creator: Miguel G. Echevarria, Samuel F. Romera, and Ignazio Scimemi
arxiv-2308-12356.description: Abstract We compute the gluon transverse-momentum-dependent fragmentation function (TMDFF) at next-to-leading order (NLO) into heavy quarkonium in the color-octet S [ 8 ] 1 3 {}^{3}S_{1}^{[8]} channel, based on the NRQCD factorization approach. The spurious rapidity divergences are explicitly shown to cancel in a well-defined TMDFF, which incorporates the needed soft factor.

arxiv-2410-19582.title: Harnessing Room-Temperature Ferroelectricity in Metal Oxide Monolayers for Advanced Logic Devices
arxiv-2410-19582.creator: Ateeb Naseer, Musaib Rafiq, Somnath Bhowmick, Amit Agarwal, Yogesh Singh Chauhan
arxiv-2410-19582.description: Abstract Two-dimensional ferroelectric materials are beneficial for power-efficient memory devices and transistor applications. Here, we predict out-of-plane ferroelectricity in a new family of buckled metal oxide (MO; M: Ge, Sn, Pb) monolayers with significant spontaneous polarization. Additionally, these monolayers have a narrow valence band, which is energetically separated from the rest of the low-lying valence bands.

arxiv-2508-02492.title: Theory of nonlinear magnetoelectric transport effects in normal-metal – magnetic-insulator heterostructures
arxiv-2508-02492.creator: Oliver Franke, Piet W. Brouwer
arxiv-2508-02492.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Oliver Franke, Piet W. Brouwer. Heterostructures of normal metals (N) and magnetic insulators (F) show paradigmatic effects, such as spin-Hall magnetoresistance and electric drag currents. These effects are linear in the applied electric field E ⁡ ( ω ) E(\omega) . Normal-metal–magnetic-insulator heterostructures also exhibit a characteristic nonlinear response quadratic in E ⁡ ( ω ) E(\omega) , referred to as unidirectional spin-Hall magnetoresistance or spin-torque diode effect.

arxiv-2510-26888.title: Optimising physical parameters of a quantum network based on a loss-jitter trade-off Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2510-26888.creator: Marcus J. Clark 1, † \dagger and Siddarth K. Joshi 1,*, Marcus J. Clark 1, † \dagger and Siddarth K. Joshi 1,*
arxiv-2510-26888.description: Abstract As quantum communication systems and networks are becoming a commercial reality, clarity on their future infrastructure is increasingly important. Based on the inevitable presence of some amount of loss, chromatic dispersion, and timing jitter, we present simulations to show that certain wavelengths and bandwidths have clear advantages.

arxiv-2512-15790.title: Bilevel Optimization for Covert Memory Tampering in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Architectures (XAMT)
arxiv-2512-15790.creator: Akhil Sharma, Shaikh Yaser Arafat, Jai Kumar Sharma, Ken Huang
arxiv-2512-15790.description: Abstract The increasing operational reliance on complex Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) across safety-critical domains necessitates a rigorous assessment of their adversarial robustness. Modern MAS are inherently heterogeneous, often integrating conventional machine learning paradigms, such as Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), with emerging Large Language Model (LLM) agent architectures utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

arxiv-2604-18261.title: DeepRitzSplit Neural Operator for Phase-Field Models via Energy Splitting
arxiv-2604-18261.creator: Chih-Kang Huang, Ludovick Gagnon, Miha Založnik, Benoît Appolaire

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-mileto.creator: Umberto Benigni
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-mileto.description: Article 'Mileto' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

doe-osti-3001405-high-fidelity-self-lear.title: High-Fidelity Self-Learning Tool for Residential Load and Load Flexibility Forecasting
doe-osti-3001405-high-fidelity-self-lear.creator: Zeifman, Michael
doe-osti-3001405-high-fidelity-self-lear.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. In this project, we developed a set of high-fidelity modeling and optimization algorithms to enable conversion of individual homes into grid-integrated buildings, and a community of homes into a virtual power plant (VPP).

plos-pone-0351632.title: Family support mediates the relationship between medication adherence and quality of life among patients with hypertension in Ghana: A cross-sectional study
plos-pone-0351632.creator: Cynthia Serwaa Akoto Osei, Jacob Solomon Idan, Edmund Baah-Akyeamfour, Bhavana Singh, Daniel Boateng
plos-pone-0351632.description: Family support mediates the relationship between medication adherence and quality of life among patients with hypertension in Ghana: A cross-sectional study

pmc-10520762.title: A Web-Based, Mail-Order Sexually Transmitted Infection Testing Program: Qualitative Analysis of User Feedback
pmc-10520762.creator: Abagail Edwards, Aries Nuño, Christopher Kemp, Emily Tillett, Gretchen Armington, Rachel Fink, Matthew M Hamill, Yukari C Manabe
pmc-10520762.description: BackgroundThe incidence of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) is increasing in the United States. The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in significant reductions in access to health care services, including STI testing and treatment, leading to underreporting of STI cases and a need for alternatives to clinic-based testing.

pmc-10689137.title: Causal effects of rheumatoid arthritis or ankylosing spondylitis on membranous nephropathy: a two-sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-10689137.creator: Xiu-Fen Wang, Shao-Bin Duan, Jian He, Xi Wu, Ting Wu
pmc-10689137.description: BackgroundMembranous nephropathy (MN) is the leading cause of adult-onset nephrotic syndrome, with primary MN of unclear cause accounting for 80% of cases. Retrospective clinical research reported that MN occurring in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and ankylosing spondylitis (AS) patients was triggered by nephrotoxic drugs or of unknown cause.

pmc-11301856.title: Response of Central Nervous System Biomolecules and Systemic Biomarkers to Aerobic Exercise Following Concussion: A Scoping Review of Human and Animal Research
pmc-11301856.creator: Dean M Cordingley, Izabella Marquez, Serena C L Buchwald, Frederick A Zeiler
pmc-11301856.description: The purpose of this study was to identify the response of biomolecules and biomarkers that are associated with the central nervous system to aerobic exercise in human and pre-clinical models of concussion or mild traumatic brain injury (TBI), and to highlight the knowledge gaps in the literature.

pmc-11577972.title: Severe Hemorrhagic Cholecystitis in the Absence of Common Predisposing Factors
pmc-11577972.creator: Cristhian Perez Torrico, Seth Williams, Brandon S Radow
pmc-11577972.description: Hemorrhagic cholecystitis is a rare and potentially life-threatening complication of acute cholecystitis. It lacks specific diagnostic and management guidelines due to its rarity. We present the case of a 70-year-old male with no typical risk factors who developed hemorrhagic cholecystitis.

pmc-11679359.title: Targeting Cancer: Microenvironment and Immunotherapy Innovations
pmc-11679359.creator: Irena Barbara Padzińska-Pruszyńska, Bartłomiej Taciak, Łukasz Kiraga, Anna Smolarska, Małgorzata Górczak, Paulina Kucharzewska, Małgorzata Kubiak, Jacek Szeliga, Agata Matejuk, Magdalena Król
pmc-11679359.description: In 2024, the United States was projected to experience 2 million new cancer diagnoses and approximately 611,720 cancer-related deaths, reflecting a broader global trend in which cancer cases are anticipated to exceed 35 million by 2050. This increasing burden highlights ongoing challenges in cancer treatment despite significant advances that have reduced cancer mortality by 31% since 1991.

pmc-11689873.title: FROM NATIONAL DATA TO LOCAL APPLICATION: INNOVATIONS IN AGING NETWORK SERVICES AND RESEARCH PARTNERSHIPS
pmc-11689873.creator: Traci Wilson, Marisa Sheldon, Heather Menne
pmc-11689873.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). As the local experts in planning, coordinating, and implementing aging services, Area Agencies on Aging (AAAs) address a broad range of social and health needs of an increasingly diverse older adult population. To live independently and with optimal health in their homes and communities, many older adults depend on Older Americans Act (OAA)-funded services such as nutrition and in-home supportive services, which they access through local AAAs.

pmc-11738764.title: Bibliometric analysis of virology advancements in the 21st century
pmc-11738764.creator: Lili Ma, Wei Pan, Jiali Si
pmc-11738764.description: Highlights•Databases of Web of Science, Essential Science Indicators, and Nature Index are utilized in the analysis.•More than one million publications, including 900,000 research articles are identified.•Annual article counts show a steady growth, with a significant surge during the COVID-19 pandemic.•Patterns across various scientific disciplines and countries are analyzed to gain an in-depth understanding of the virology research landscape.

pmc-12745561.title: Percutaneous vs Open First Metatarsophalangeal Joint Arthrodesis: A Proportional Meta-Analysis and Systematic Review
pmc-12745561.creator: Antonio Izzo, Martina D'Agostino, Vincenzo De Matteo, Giovanni Baldi, Alessio Bernasconi
pmc-12745561.description: Research Type:Level 4 – Case seriesIntroduction/Purpose:First metatarsophalangeal joint (MTPJ-1) arthrodesis (MTPJA-1) is the gold standard to treat end-stage osteoarthritis of this joint. The purpose of this study was to determine whether percutaneous techniques to perform MTPJA-1 might reduce the nonunion, complication and reoperation rate as compared to the traditional open approach.

pmc-12997339.title: Nutrient-driven histone acetylation underlies energy storage and mobilization
pmc-12997339.creator: Linyun Chen, Lingyan Zhu, Huabing Xiao, Xiaotao Wang, Fan Xia, Zhichao Wang, Long Wu, Dayu Wu, Qi Liu, Junyun Cheng, Jun Qi, Qiong Duan
pmc-12997339.description: In natural settings, energy storage and mobilization maintain a dynamic balance in response to recurrent overfeeding and fasting. Imbalanced energy storage and mobilization lead to a variety of metabolic dysfunctions. However, whether the metabolic status directly couples with epigenetic modifications and transcriptional outputs remains unclear.

pmc-13020296.title: Molecular genetic examination of Circadian Clock Associated 1 gene (CCA1) in hexaploid wheat
pmc-13020296.creator: Ádám D. Horváth, Tibor Kiss, Balázs Kalapos, Ildikó Karsai, András Cseh
pmc-13020296.description: BackgroundThe circadian clock is one of the most crucial regulatory pathways controlling plant development and stress responses, with the CIRCADIAN CLOCK ASSOCIATED 1 (CCA1) gene playing a central role. While the regulatory mechanisms and structure of this gene have been well characterized in Arabidopsis thaliana L., only limited information is available for hexaploid wheat.

pmc-13053957.title: Dextrocardia with Situs Inversus Totalis in an Ethiopian Woman: A Case Report
pmc-13053957.creator: Tsegaab Mesele, Kebron W. Aweke, Gelila S. Kassa, Mikiyas G. Teferi, Muluken Bekele Wondimagegnehu, Leul M. Manyazewal, Samuel Dereje Bedada
pmc-13053957.description: Dextrocardia with situs inversus totalis (SIT) is a rare congenital anomaly involving complete mirror-image reversal of thoracic and abdominal organs, which may complicate diagnostic evaluation and management despite often being benign. We report a 45-year-old Ethiopian woman with type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension who presented with dry cough, right-sided pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, and low-grade fever.

pmc-13236200.title: The quiet cost of gender bias in the operating room
pmc-13236200.creator: Javeria Akhter, Muhammad Nouman Javed, Waleed Ahmed, Muhammad Noshab
pmc-13236200.description: Surgical specialties continue to be dominated by men, even though women make up more than 50% of medical school graduates. Female surgeons’ self-esteem, career paths, and well-being are destroyed by overt discrimination and microaggressions, which also have an impact on team dynamics and patient safety.

pmc-13399095.title: High‐Fidelity Measurement‐Based Detection Values and Roles of Three‐Dimensional Joint Space Width in Evaluation of Knee Osteoarthritis
pmc-13399095.creator: Elena Tahir, Zhi Zhang, Dangfeng Zhang, Hussnain Tahir, Huida Wang, Xing Ma
pmc-13399095.description: Objective3D joint space width (JSW) mapping quantifies structural narrowing in knee osteoarthritis (OA), but the effect of surface mesh resolution on measurement reliability and precision remains unclear. This study assessed how mesh resolution influences 3D JSW measurements, whether effects differ by metric and OA severity, and which resolutions best preserve OA group‐level discrimination and subject‐level agreement.

pmc-13400720.title: Relationship Status and Quality Associations with HIV Care Cascade Outcomes Among Sexual Minority Men Living with HIV in the US: Indications of a Dyadic Coping Paradox
pmc-13400720.creator: Joseph R Hillesheim, Tyrel J Starks
pmc-13400720.description: Dyadic coping among sexual minority men (SMM) has been a focus of HIV prevention research for decades, but few studies have examined relationship quality as a covariate of HIV care cascade outcomes (ART adherence and an undetectable viral load (VL)).

pmc-13661756.title: Improved detection of local tumor progression after ablation or resection of colorectal liver metastases using [18F]FDG-PET/contrast-enhanced CT versus contrast-enhanced CT alone: results from a Dutch prospective cohort
pmc-13661756.creator: O. D. Bijlstra, S. van Mossel, B. Boekestijn, M. C. Burgmans, E. L. van Persijn van Meerten, D. D. D. Rietbergen, S. Shahbazi Feshtali, R. J. Swijnenburg, F. H. P. van Velden, H. Koffijberg, L. F. de Geus-Oei, J. S. D. Mieog
pmc-13661756.description: ObjectivePost-treatment surveillance after locally treated colorectal liver metastases involves CEA measurement and contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) scans. However, reactive tissue around ablated lesions can appear similar to viable tumor tissue on CECT, complicating the detection of local tumor progression (LTP). Therefore, a new imaging protocol was initiated, which incorporates [18F]FDG-PET/CT to complement CECT.
